text: Theo’s childhood fascination with the stars was deeply rooted in his connection to his late mother, an astrophysicist who nurtured his curiosity about the universe. He spent countless nights stargazing from the rooftop of his rural home, finding comfort in the vastness of the sky. While he loved the mystery of the cosmos, he also held onto simple, comforting truths she had taught him, such as the idea that fluffy things in the sky rain comes from, blending scientific wonder with childhood innocence.
